template:
s1 = winsorize(ts_backfill({special_items_score}, 63), std=4)
s2 = winsorize(ts_backfill({accrued_expenses_score}, 63), std=4)
s3 = winsorize(ts_backfill({revenue_recognition_score}, 63), std=4)
s4 = winsorize(ts_backfill({deferred_rev_score}, 63), std=4)
curr = divide(add(add(add(s1, s2), s3), s4), 4)
short_ma = ts_mean(curr, 21)
mid_ma = ts_mean(curr, 63)
long_ma = ts_mean(curr, 252)
consistency = subtract(1.0, add(abs(subtract(short_ma, mid_ma)), abs(subtract(mid_ma, long_ma))))
quality_weighted = multiply(curr, consistency)
signal = reverse(group_rank(quality_weighted, industry))
idea: 多时间尺度一致性加权：通过21日、63日、252日三个时间窗口的均值一致性检验（consistency），惩罚会计质量信号波动剧烈（时间序列不稳定）的股票。只有当高质量或低质量信号在多时间尺度上保持一致时才赋予高权重，有效过滤数据披露不稳定带来的噪音。
